structure: Part 1, Dashboards and drill-downs: the 8 traces of dashboard.fit.spec.js, each opened and mined in full (Playwright 1.61.1, one page per navigation, 0 errors recorded). Traces and the pages they reach, in order: (1) overall dashboard › the prototype index lists every design release: /design-release-2.1/index, four release cards, the 'Start design release 2.1' link. (2) overall dashboard › /dashboard redirects: GET /design-release-2.1/dashboard 302 to /design-release-2.1, and /dashboard?tab=drafts 302 to /live-animals?tab=drafts. (3) overall dashboard › summarises every category: /design-release-2.1 (overall dashboard: intro, Messages, Create new, Use template, Live animals / Germinal products / Plants sections with glance cards and View dashboard links; the plants section is a placeholder linking to '#'). (4) category dashboards › live animals: /design-release-2.1/live-animals (Summary glance cards, Notifications search + sort, Additional filters panel with arrival-date radios, MOJ date pickers and status select, server-side tabs In progress / Draft / Completed with notification cards, and a search submitted as GET). (5) category dashboards › germinal products: /design-release-2.1/germinal-products (same layout, Number of packages instead of Number of animals; only the In progress tab opened). (6) at a glance drill-downs › action needed: /design-release-2.1/actions, unfiltered then ?category=live-animals. (7) drill-downs › inspection required: /design-release-2.1/inspection with its 'What to do at a border inspection' details opened. (8) drill-downs › status updated: /design-release-2.1/changes, unfiltered then ?category=germinal-products. Shared chrome claimed once: service navigation, phase banner, prototype footer. Every page is server-rendered by the prototype kit with no data API calls. Claims run page by page in that order (index, chrome, redirect, overall dashboard, live-animals dashboard, germinal dashboard, Action needed, Status updated, Inspection required, cross-page observations), then five later claims (119-123): the plants section's own style modifier, the index navigation with no current item, the date picker calendar, the card's accessible name, and category glance counts matching the drill-downs. Stops at links out of the dashboard: create-notification, templates, view/copy are other parts. Gaps recorded: sort effect, filter effect, pagination/empty states, germinal Draft/Completed tabs, unseen change types, the inspection drill-down's category view and entry point, Messages, and the plants dashboard.
